text: SEASONAL OUTLOOK - Red River valley, spring 2027 (Mar-Jun): flood risk near normal. Too early for a confident outlook. Next update Dec 1.
SEASONAL OUTLOOK - Red River valley, spring 2027 (Mar-Jun): flood risk ABOVE normal due to heavy early snowfall. Start planning for a possible late or wet planting season.

SEASONAL OUTLOOK - Red River valley, spring 2027 (Mar-Jun): HIGH flood risk. Expect wet fields into May. Consider shorter-season crops for low areas and move stored grain and equipment to higher ground.

SEASONAL OUTLOOK - Red River valley, spring 2027 (Apr-Jun): HIGH flood risk. Melt is underway. Delay sowing on low-lying fields until water recedes. Short-term alerts will follow if flooding is imminent.
